people.imagined: The painting table in the small hours, a single tall silver candle burning beside her. She has sat so still over the page that three moths have settled on her sleeve, and she does not move them. A brush is poised a hair above the paper.
people.subject: The moment: sitting motionless at a low painting table at night, a brush held a hair above the paper, moths resting on her sleeve. Face: a slight, fine-boned, serene face with high small cheekbones, calm pale-grey eyes lowered to the page, thin straight grey brows, a small straight nose, a gentle closed mouth, skin very fine and lightly lined; a faint smudge of soot on one temple; about fifty-five. Hair: pure grey, fine and straight, drawn back and bound in a low knot at the nape, with a slim bamboo brush stuck through it. Body: slight, small-shouldered, utterly upright and still, the stillness of long practice. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, cross-collared with narrow sleeves, flecked here and there with grey soot-marks; a black cord tied at the left wrist; a faint violet edge at the cuff, the colour of the Hall's fungus dye. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a slender brush of dark wood poised over a long strip of pale paper bearing seven small black dots in the shape of a ladle; the left hand rests flat beside a small black gourd of ink; a tall silver candlestick with a white wax candle stands at the table's edge; three pale moths on the black sleeve. Background: a bare dark room with a single high window and shelves of rolled paper, blurred. Light: the candle from the upper right, a soft warm circle on her face and the paper. Expression: stillness, devotion, concentrated calm. A faint pale-green Wood glimmer at the brush tip. Palette: black, candle gold, soft grey.

people.imagined: The Hall's great painting room at midday. She is talking while she paints, which no one else dares, a boxwood seal swinging on its cord, ink to the elbow, mid-sentence about a price.
people.subject: The moment: painting rapidly at a long table while talking over her shoulder to someone out of frame, her brush flying. Face: a long, lively, handsome face with a strong jaw, quick dark eyes under thick arched brows, a long nose, a wide mobile mouth caught mid-word; a black ink streak across the cheek; about forty. Hair: black, in a high knot pierced by two slim brushes, a loose strand at the temple. Body: tall, long-limbed, leaning over the table with one hip against its edge, restless energy in every angle. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, the sleeves pushed up to the elbow and the forearms ink-black from wrist to elbow, a black cord at the left wrist, a narrow violet band at the cuff; a leather apron over the front. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand mid-stroke over a strip of yellow paper marked with seven dots; hanging on a cord at her chest a small boxwood seal carved with seven dots and a handle, swinging; a row of seven brushes in a stand. Background: a long bright painting room with rows of tables and dozens of bowed painters, blurred, rolled papers hung on a line to dry. Light: bright daylight from tall windows on the upper left. Expression: lively, ambitious, a little greedy, impatient. A faint pale-green Wood hint at the ink. Palette: ink black, paper yellow, violet.

people.imagined: The cabinet of a thousand ink sticks in his kiln-house. He has pulled one stick out, sniffed it, and is naming its year before reading the label, with a stubborn old smile through his burnt eyebrows.
people.subject: The moment: holding a black ink stick to his nose in front of a huge cabinet of small drawers, eyes closed, lips moving as he names its year. Face (most important: black hands and burnt eyebrows): a lined, leathery old face with a big hooked nose, deep-set black eyes, bald spots where the eyebrows were burnt away leaving only a few singed stubs, a wide stubborn mouth, a grey stubble; the cheeks smudged with soot; about seventy. Hair: thin grey, in a knot, a black cloth tied round the head. Body: stocky, short, bent forward, broad strong shoulders, a charcoal burner's frame. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, soot-stained and clean, cross-collared, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a black cord at the left wrist, a thick leather apron; a faint violet edge at the cuff. Hands and objects: both hands black to the wrist as if dipped in ink; in the right a long black ink stick with a gold mark; before him a wall cabinet of a thousand tiny drawers each with a small paper tag; a lamp on a hook. Background: the cabinet rows and a kiln-house with a glowing mouth seen through an arch, blurred. Light: orange kiln glow from the lower right, a warm lamp from the upper left. Expression: stubborn, absorbed, secretive. A faint dark-green Wood hint of pine smoke. Palette: black, kiln orange, grey.

people.imagined: The archive courtyard in the city, his one day a month. He stands neat and soft-spoken in Pivot grey with a black cord at his wrist, glancing back over his shoulder at the archive windows, wanting to walk home.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an archive courtyard in Pivot-grey clerk's dress, a small package of ink sticks under his arm, glancing back over his shoulder at windows. Face: a neat, soft, pleasant face with kind brown eyes, level mild brows, a small nose, a small closed mouth, a clean-shaven chin; faint ink on the left thumb; about forty. Hair: black, combed and tied in a neat topknot under a plain grey clerk's cap. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, upright, a clerk's careful posture. Clothing: a robe of Pivot grey cloth, a high collar buttoned to the chin, plain narrow sleeves, a neat grey sash; at the left wrist a black cord, the one mark of the Hall, tied in a flat knot. Hands and objects: a long flat parcel of black ink sticks wrapped in blue cloth under the left arm; in the right hand a small brass key; ink on the left thumb. Background: a stone courtyard with an arched gate, rows of identical windows of a tall archive building, a few clerks in grey, blurred. Light: flat cool daylight from the upper left. Expression: loyal, cautious, longing for home. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: archive grey, ink black, cloth blue.

people.imagined: The dye vats of the village at dusk, steam rising violet. She stands with her arms folded and her purse inside her sash, where no one has ever seen it open, adding up the price of the violet in her head.
people.subject: The moment: standing in front of a steaming dye vat at dusk with her arms folded, calculating, her hands tinted violet to the second knuckle. Face: a broad, practical, sun-browned face with sharp small eyes, thick straight brows, a short nose, a thin mouth pulled tight in thought; a smear of violet on the chin; about forty-five. Hair: black with some grey, in a tight bun under a black cloth head-wrap. Body: stocky, square, strong, planted wide. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with sleeves rolled, a black cord at the left wrist, a broad belt-like sash wound tight round the waist hiding a flat purse; a leather apron stained violet. Hands and objects: both hands violet to the second knuckle, folded at the elbow; behind her a vat of deep violet liquid with a wooden paddle and steam; a stack of dyed grey paper drying on a rack; a dark fungus the size of a plate on a board. Background: a village of low sooty houses at the foot of pines, smoke from several vats, a long line of dyed cloth, blurred. Light: low violet-pink dusk light from the left, steam glowing. Expression: pragmatic, shrewd, closed. A faint pale-violet Wood hint in the steam. Palette: violet, black, dusk pink.

people.imagined: The head's room in the early morning. She sweeps the floor with a stoop, and when the head turns away she smiles a beat after everyone else has stopped, calculating what she may take from the Silver Candle's teaching.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a broom in a bare room, she looks up with a smile that comes a moment after the conversation has ended. Face: a young, round, pleasant face with soft brown eyes, short straight brows, a small nose, a little pink mouth whose smile arrives late and stays too long; a smudge of dust on the forehead; about twenty-four. Hair: black, in a plain bun tied with a black cord, a bamboo brush stuck through it. Body: sturdy, small, stooping as she sweeps, shoulders rounded. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with sleeves tied back by a black cord at the wrist, a short apron, plain black shoes; the hem is dusty. Hands and objects: both hands on a long-handled broom of twigs; beside her on the floor a small black ink stone and a bundle of brushes; a tall silver candlestick with a white candle in the corner of the room, glowing. Background: a bare dark room with a low painting table, a high window, rolled papers on a shelf, blurred. Light: pale early light from the window at the upper left and a thin gold line from the candle. Expression: eager, deferential, secretly ambitious. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: black, candle gold, dust grey.

people.imagined: The Hall's painting room, midday. In a place where everyone else's cuffs are black with ink his are perfectly clean, and he is painting the seventh star with a calm, almost lazy steadiness.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a table painting a single dot with a calm, lazy steadiness, his clean cuffs prominent. Face: a smooth, mild, handsome young face with large calm dark eyes, soft level brows, a straight nose, a faint idle smile; no smudge anywhere; about twenty. Hair: black, in a neat knot with a slim brush through it. Body: lean, relaxed, leaning back a little with one elbow on the table. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with spotless cuffs and sleeves rolled up neatly twice, a black cord at the left wrist, a plain black sash; the cleanest garment in the room. Hands and objects: a thin brush held in the right hand over a strip of paper that has six dots already and a space for the seventh; the hands themselves are clean; a small cake of pine nuts wrapped in leaf lies on the table; a stack of finished strips beside. Background: the long painting room with rows of painters bent over tables, all with black cuffs, blurred. Light: bright window light from the upper left. Expression: calm, humble, quietly lazy. A faint pale-green Wood hint at the brush. Palette: black, paper yellow, soft green.

people.imagined: On the sloping roof of a soot kiln at noon, black from hair to heel, singing off-key as she scrapes soot into a basket. Her teeth are the only white thing about her.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a kiln roof with a scraper in her hand, mouth wide open in song, black with soot from head to foot. Face (most important: black with soot and white teeth): a round, cheerful face entirely blackened with soot, white teeth in a huge grin, bright black eyes with white corners, round cheeks; about seventeen. Hair: black, in two rough braids coated in soot and tied with black cord. Body: sturdy, strong-armed, standing wide and easy on the sloping roof. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth of which sleeves and hems are caked with soot, a black cord at the left wrist; an apron of leather; bare feet blackened. Hands and objects: a flat iron scraper in the right hand; a wide basket of fine black soot on her hip; a cloth tied over the nose pushed down to her chin; a small oil lamp on a hook. Background: the kiln mouths glowing red, a slope of tall vermilion-trunked pines, thick dark smoke rising, blurred. Light: bright noon light from the upper left, orange kiln glow below. Expression: cheerful, brave, off-key. A faint soft green Wood hint in the smoke. Palette: soot black, pine red, white teeth.

people.imagined: The archive courtyard, a copyists' stall. He laughs so loudly that heads turn across the courtyard, one ear always inked, handing a cup of wine to a copyist and trading a little too much gossip for it.
people.subject: The moment: at a copyists' stall in an archive courtyard he laughs loudly with his head thrown back, a cup of wine in his hand. Face (most important: one inked ear): a round, merry, red-cheeked face with crinkled bright eyes, a wide laughing mouth, a snub nose; the right ear is stained black with ink as if dipped; about nineteen. Hair: black, tousled, tied in a knot with a grey cloth. Body: stocky, lively, one foot up on the stall rail, a swagger in the shoulders. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with the sleeves tied back, a black cord at the left wrist, a Pivot-grey apron over it; ink at the cuffs. Hands and objects: a small clay wine cup raised in the right hand; a long ink stick in the left hand with a gold stripe; a pouch of ink sticks hanging at his belt. Background: a courtyard of stalls with copyists at low desks, a tall grey archive wall, blurred. Light: bright daylight from the upper left. The laughing mouth shows a gap in the lower teeth, and the black ear stands out sharp against the pale wall. Expression: loud, friendly, fickle. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: black, archive grey, wine red.

people.imagined: On the fungus slope, a small dark-eyed girl re-pinning a twig of deer-grass in her hair for the hundredth time, nose wrinkled at a smell that tells her a glue yard is boiling somewhere nearby.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a fungus slope, a small hand pinning a twig of deer-grass in her hair, nose wrinkled at a smell on the wind. Face: a small, dark-eyed, serious face with large dark eyes, fine straight brows, a small nose wrinkled up, a small anxious mouth; about sixteen. Hair: black, long, in a loose braid, with a twig of pale deer-grass pinned at the side of the head. Body: small, slight, light-footed, shoulders narrow. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, shortened at the hem for walking, a black cord at the left wrist, a small satchel for fungus; leather shoes. Hands and objects: the left hand reaching up to the twig in her hair; the right holding a flat basket of dark grey fungus the size of saucers; a small knife at her belt. Her sleeve is dusted with spore powder, a few grey caps lie in the basket with their gills showing pale, and a single deer lifts its head below her. Background: a damp slope of dark pines with pale fungus on logs, a little meadow below with deer standing in it, a faint column of smoke from a yard, blurred. Light: soft green-grey light from the upper left. Expression: cautious, honest, worried. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: grey fungus, black, meadow green.

people.imagined: The year she founded the Hall in 910: a short fungus-dyer's daughter with violet nails, a brush in each hand, painting the seven stars of the Dipper on a long scroll with both hands at once.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A short woman holds a brush in each hand, a long scroll of the Dipper before her, looking up with fierce calm. Face: a broad, short-jawed, firm face with sharp black eyes, thick straight brows, a short nose, a closed wide mouth, deep lines at the eyes; about forty-five. Hair: black, in a tight topknot with two brushes thrust through it. Body: short, stocky, strong shouldered, planted wide. Clothing: a plain robe of dark-grey cloth with a black sash, the sleeves rolled and tied, a leather apron stained with ink and violet dye; the earliest form of the Hall's black. Hands and objects: a brush in each hand, one dipped in black and the other in red; every fingernail stained a deep violet, clearly visible; a long scroll of pale paper before her with seven dots in the shape of a ladle; a small black pot of ink and a lump of ink stick. Background: a dim room with a tall window onto pines, a cabinet of small tools, blurred. Light: soft light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: fierce, devout, patient. A faint violet shimmer at the fingers. Palette: faded black, violet, old paper.

people.imagined: Among the vermilion pines at the kilns, she raps her tapping-rod on the ground before she speaks, counting the trees the kilns have burned, her thumb yellow with pitch.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pine wood, she raps a long wooden tapping-rod on the ground and looks hard at someone before she speaks. Face (most important: pitch-yellow thumb): a lean, tough, sun-browned face with a long straight nose, narrow grey eyes, firm straight brows, a thin mouth set honestly; about forty-five. Hair: black with grey streaks, in a tight bun under a straw hat. Body: lean, straight, a long stride, shoulders squared. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, kilted at the knee for the woods, a black cord at the left wrist, a leather apron spotted with resin, strong boots. Hands and objects: the right thumb stained deep yellow-brown with pitch, held up against the rod; a long tapping-rod of dark wood with an iron tip in the right hand; a small gourd of resin at the belt; a tally of notched sticks in a pouch. Background: tall vermilion-trunked pines in rows, each with a scarred tapping-cut, a thin trail of smoke from a kiln, blurred. Light: shafts of low gold light through the trunks from the upper left. Expression: pragmatic, hard, honest. A faint soft green Wood hint in the pine. Palette: pine red, black, resin amber.

people.imagined: The painting table, the smell of the kilns heavy in the air, a dried persimmon in his sleeve against it. He paints with his left hand, calm and stubborn, a letter from his friend's mother waiting in his sash.
people.subject: The moment: painting with his left hand at a long table, a dried persimmon peeking from his right sleeve, absorbed. Face: a calm, square, steady face with level brown eyes, strong straight brows, a straight nose, a closed firm mouth, a clean-shaven chin; about forty. Hair: black, in a tidy knot with a slim brush through it. A grey hair or two shows at the temple, and the knot is tied slightly off-centre. Body: broad, steady, sitting upright with a lean toward the left hand. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with cuffs inked to the wrist, a black cord at the left wrist, a plain black sash; from the right sleeve peeks a round orange dried persimmon. Hands and objects: a thin brush in the left hand over a strip of paper with dots in the shape of the Dipper's middle stars; the right hand flat on the table; a folded letter tied with red thread in the sash. Background: the painting room with tables and painters bent over, a high window, blurred. Light: window light from the upper left. The orange of the persimmon is the only warm colour in the black room. Expression: calm, stubborn, loyal. A faint pale-green Wood hint at the brush. Palette: black, persimmon orange, paper yellow.

people.imagined: The kiln mouths at night, counting them twice with his lips moving, a cracked front tooth showing, half sure the fault is in the soot and not his hand, watching the boys' hands.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a row of glowing kiln mouths at night, his lips moving as he counts them, then counts again. Face (most important: the cracked front tooth): a sharp, thin, tense face with narrow suspicious dark eyes, thick straight brows, a long nose, a mouth parted in the count to show a front tooth with a visible crack through it; about nineteen. Hair: black, short, bristling, soot on the forehead. Body: wiry, tight-shouldered, stiff and watchful. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with sleeves rolled, a black cord at the left wrist, a leather apron scorched at the edges; boots. Hands and objects: a long iron poker in the right hand; the left held up with the fingers counting; a lantern hanging from a hook at his side; a strip of yellow talisman paper smeared with a run of black ink tucked in his belt. Soot streaks his cheeks, a thread of sweat cuts through it at the temple, and the glow of the kilns reflects in each of his narrowed eyes. Background: four kiln mouths glowing orange in a row, smoke, dark pines beyond, blurred. Light: orange kiln light from the lower left on the face. Expression: stubborn, hard, suspicious. A faint dark-green Wood hint in the smoke. Palette: kiln orange, black, ash grey.

people.imagined: At the dye vats in the steam, coughing as the vapour turns. Dyed blue-black to the wrist, she has asked only to be left here and never taught to paint, and she hums, content.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a dye vat in turning steam, one hand pressed to her mouth as she coughs, the other stirring a black cord in the dye. Face: a soft, pale, round face with small close-set kind eyes, soft brows, a button nose, a small mouth; the cheeks flushed by steam; about seventeen. Hair: black, in a loose bun under a cloth wrapped round the head. Damp wisps stick to her cheeks. Body: small, round-shouldered, patient, a slight stoop. Her shoulders are narrow and her wrists thin, with a fine tremor of cough through the ribs. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, short-sleeved, a black cord at the left wrist, a wet leather apron; the hems damp. The apron is plastered with fungus-grey and violet splashes and tied twice at the back; the black robe has been let down at the hem and edged with a lighter black band. Hands and objects: both hands dyed blue-black to the wrist, plainly visible; the right holding a long wooden paddle lifting a dripping black cord from the vat; a rack of cords drying behind. Background: Behind her several racks of black cord and cloth hang in dripping rows and a stack of grey logs with fungus lies beside a stone trough. Light: soft damp light from the upper left, steam glowing faintly violet. A pale shaft cuts through the steam and gives the vat's surface a violet sheen. Expression: content, humble, a little ill. A faint pale violet-green hint in the steam. Palette: blue-black, steam grey, violet.

people.imagined: A painter's corridor, a kiln boy paying her a copper to be let off carrying her brushes, the two brass hairpins in her hair not Hall issue. She holds out a hand, her chin high.
people.subject: The moment: in a corridor she holds out her hand for a copper from a kiln boy out of frame, chin high, looking down her nose. Face: a pretty, sharp, proud face with narrow dark eyes, thin arched brows, a straight nose, a thin mouth turned in disdain; about twenty-two. Hair: black, in a high knot with two shiny brass hairpins in the shape of small leaves, clearly not matching the Hall's plain bamboo brushes. Body: slender, tall for her age, upright, hips tilted in a swagger. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, neat and well cut, sleeves slim, a black cord at the left wrist, a violet edge at the cuff; a thin chain of brass at the neck. Hands and objects: the right palm open, held out for the copper; the left holds a bundle of seven brushes wrapped in a black cloth; a small bag at the belt. A smudge of green pigment marks her left sleeve, and her heavy-lidded eyes sweep the boy from his boots to his collar. Background: a dim corridor with paper lanterns, a row of closed doors, a small kiln boy half in frame, blurred. Light: a lantern from the upper left, brass glints in her hair. Expression: Chin high, looking down her nose, with a hard, proud gleam in the eyes and a grasping, ambitious set to the mouth. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: ink-black, bronze, amethyst.

people.imagined: The archive courtyard, sitting on a step with the Hall's book on his knee, copying ink orders. His left sleeve is inked to the elbow, and he looks up earnestly when his master asks for a page of 1195.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stone step with an open book on his knee, copying with a brush, looking up earnestly at his master out of frame. Face: a young, round, honest face with large trusting brown eyes, soft brows, a short nose, an open mouth; ink on the cheek; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a short topknot with a grey cloth. A cowlick stands up at the back of the head. Body: slight, earnest, hunched over the book. He sits with his knees apart and his shoulders pitched forward, the book propped on his thigh, back bent like a heron's neck. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth with the left sleeve inked black to the elbow from copying, a black cord at the left wrist, an apron; neat otherwise. The black robe has the right sleeve clean and the left blotched with ink, both cuffs tied with black cord; the belt holds a small satchel with a ruler and an ink stick. Hands and objects: a thin brush in the right hand; the book open on the knee with ruled columns of small plain strokes; a small ink stone at his side; the left forearm black to the elbow. Background: a stone archive courtyard with a tall grey wall and windows, copyists in the distance, blurred. Behind him tall windows of the archive in a regular grid, a wooden bench with other boys, and a clay water jar by the step. Light: bright daylight from the upper left. Hard clear light from above makes a small sharp shadow under the book. Expression: honest, trusting, diligent. A faint pale-green Wood hint. Palette: black, archive grey, paper cream.

people.imagined: The deer meadow of Lộc Uyển, with his white forelock he blames on a stag. He stands among grazing deer, smelling faintly of them, refusing in his heart to paint with deer glue.
people.subject: The moment: standing among grazing deer in a meadow, his hand resting on a hind's neck, looking calmly at the viewer. Face (most important: a white forelock): an honest, quiet, lean face with calm brown eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a closed mouth; a streak of pure white hair at the front of the black hair like a stag's blaze; about twenty-one. Hair: black with a prominent white forelock, tied back in a short tail. Body: lean, easy, calm, still, with the soft movements of someone used to animals. Clothing: a black robe of close matte cloth, shortened at the hem, a black cord at the left wrist, a small satchel; boots caked with meadow mud. Hands and objects: the left hand resting flat on a deer's neck; the right holding a small fungus basket; a few pale deer hairs on his sleeve; a gourd at the belt. Background: a green meadow with several deer grazing, dark pines behind, a pale sky, blurred. Light: soft clear light from the upper left. A pale morning glow slants across the grass and gleams on the deer's coats and on his white forelock. Expression: honest, cautious, just. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: meadow green, deer brown, black.
